title: 1 m x 1 m sightline truncation either side of a ROW driveway
text: Walls, fences and other structures truncated or reduced to no higher than 0.75m within a 1m x 1m sightline truncation on either side of a driveway where vehicle access is taken from a right-of-way (refer Figure 3.7d).

replaces.note: C3.7.6 path-offset exemption is new to Part B

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

notes: Condition uses site.access_from_rear_row; a side ROW access would also trigger the clause but has no fact (parking.access.street_type == row is the alternative).

verified.note: Values (0.75m, 1m x 1m) confirmed. The page triggers on access 'taken from a right-of-way' (not only a rear one); the condition uses site.access_from_rear_row, so a side ROW access is missed. parking.access.street_type == row would match the page; not changed here because it alters the ch2/ch3 pairing signature.
